# Frozen natural-language journey phrasings

| ID | Journey | Chinese | English |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| J01 | Event trend | 帮我看看登录事件这周每天的次数，按渠道拆开，并只看安卓用户。 | Show me the daily login event count this week, split by channel and filtered to Android users. |
| J02 | Funnel | 我想看从打开商品页到加入购物车再到付款的转化漏斗。 | Build a conversion funnel from viewing a product to adding it to the cart and then paying. |
| J03 | Retention | 看一下新用户首次登录后，第 1 天和第 7 天还有多少人回来。 | Show day-1 and day-7 retention after a user's first login. |
| J04 | Property | 帮我看用户所在城市的分布，并汇总每个城市的人数。 | Show the distribution of users by city and aggregate the user count for each city. |
| J05 | Scatter | 我想画个散点图，看看每个渠道的付费人数和付费金额有没有关系。 | Plot the relationship between payer count and payment amount for each channel as a scatter chart. |
| J06 | Period compare | 用同一个活跃用户分析，对比本周和上周的结果。 | Compare this week's and last week's results using the same active-user analysis definition. |
| J07 | Segment rule | 这组“近 30 天付费两次以上”的人群条件能圈中多少人，占全部用户多少？ | How many users match the rule “paid at least twice in the last 30 days,” and what share of all users is that? |
| J08 | Analysis context | 我要搭一个新分析，先把这个 App 可用的事件、属性、指标和分析模板一次给我。 | I am building a new analysis; give me the available events, properties, metrics, and analysis templates for this app in one go. |
| J09 | Governance | 给我一份这个 App 当前的容量、角色、可用菜单和实时事件治理概览。 | Give me a current snapshot of this app's capacity, roles, available menus, and real-time event governance. |
| J10 | Attribution | 把这个 App 已配置的归因规则、字段映射和回溯窗口汇总给我。 | Summarize the attribution rules, field mappings, and lookback settings configured for this app. |
| J11 | User journey | 帮我查这个用户昨天的用户画像、行为时间线和回传记录。 | Show this user's profile, event timeline, and callback records for yesterday. |
| J12 | Business pulse | 把这几个 App 最近一周的业务趋势和今天逐小时的变化汇总一下。 | Summarize the last week's business trends and today's hourly pulse across these apps. |
| J13 | Company usage | 看一下公司最近一个月的资源用量变化趋势。 | Show the company's resource usage trend over the last month. |
| J14 | Custom audiences | 我想知道各平台上的自定义人群覆盖了多少用户，现在是可用、同步中还是失败。 | Show how many users each custom audience covers across platforms and whether it is ready, syncing, or failed. |
| J15 | Material performance | 对比一下各个已支持投放平台的素材表现，看看哪些素材消耗高但转化差。 | Compare creative performance across supported ad platforms and identify creatives with high spend but poor conversion. |
| J16 | Order directory | 给我 8 月 1 日的订单目录，不要带用户标识。 | Give me the order directory for August 1 without user identifiers. |
| J17 | Order trace | 我有一个 TraceID，帮我追踪它在 8 月 1 日拆成了哪些订单。 | I have a TraceID; trace which orders it was split into on August 1. |
| J18 | Monetization detail | 查一下 8 月 1 日逐笔变现明细，不要带用户标识。 | Retrieve the row-level monetization details for August 1 without user identifiers. |
| J19 | SQL product | 运行 workspace 里登记好的“每日付费汇总”分析。 | Run the registered “daily payment summary” analysis from this workspace. |
| J20 | Dashboard snapshot | 打开这个看板的详情，顺便告诉我有哪些成员和保存的筛选条件。 | Show this dashboard's details, including its members and saved filters. |
| J21 | Dashboard replay | 按看板原来的图表配置和页面筛选条件，把整张看板重新跑一遍。 | Replay the whole dashboard using its original chart configuration and page-level filters. |
| J22 | Saved analysis | 我有一个已保存分析的精确引用，按它原来的定义重新跑出结果。 | I have the exact reference to a saved analysis; rerun it with its original definition. |
| J23 | Analysis template | 按这个分析模板的精确引用重放一次，不要改模板里的定义。 | Replay this analysis template by its exact reference without changing its definition. |
| J24 | Segment snapshot | 查看这个分群的详情、版本记录，以及昨天的聚合人数结果。 | Show this segment's details, version history, and aggregate user count for yesterday. |
| J25 | Multidim | 按省份和渠道两个物理维度，读取收入和付费人数指标，并筛选安卓用户。 | Read a multidimensional report by the physical dimensions province and channel, with revenue and payer-count metrics, filtered to Android users. |
| J26 | Promotion performance | 查巨量平台上这些 App 上周的消耗、点击和转化表现。 | Show spend, clicks, and conversions for these apps on the Bytedance ad platform last week. |
| J27 | Bilibili performance | 看一下 B 站账户和产品最近七天的投放表现。 | Show advertising performance for the Bilibili account and products over the last seven days. |
| J28 | Advertiser profile | 列出巨量广告主的消耗、账户余额、预算模式和当前状态。 | List each Bytedance advertiser's spend, account balance, budget mode, and current status. |
| J29 | Title packages | 对比巨量普通标题包和标准标题包的标题数、关联计划数和成本表现。 | Compare regular and standard Bytedance title packages by title count, linked campaign count, and cost performance. |
| J30 | Metadata search | 不联网，帮我找一下本地目录里有哪些和“付费”相关的事件、属性、指标或分析模板。 | Without going online, find events, properties, metrics, or analysis templates related to “payment” in the local catalog. |
| J31 | Table lineage | 查一下已经同步过的数据表有哪些版本，并告诉我观察到哪些变更。 | Show the versions of synced data tables and the changes that have been observed. |
| J32 | Material export | 帮我生成一份素材分析报表，等它完成后下载到本地。 | Create a creative-analysis report, wait for it to finish, and download it locally. |
| J33 | Default dictionary | 我想查看分析页面可用的默认值字典。 | Show the default-value dictionary available to analysis queries. |
| J34 | Realtime events | 列出当前能看到的实时事件目录，并告诉我每条事件的基本信息。 | List the real-time event catalog I can access and show the basic details for each event. |
| J35 | Report directory | 帮我找出我自己的、别人共享给我的以及 MasterKey 报表，并读取报表定义。 | Find my own reports, reports shared with me, and MasterKey reports, then read their definitions. |
| J36 | Report subscriptions | 列出我当前订阅了哪些报表。 | List the reports I am currently subscribed to. |
| J37 | Media reports | 帮我找一下现在有哪些可用的媒体投放报表。 | Find the media advertising reports that are currently available. |
| J38 | App projects | 列出当前账号有权限读取的 App 项目。 | List the app projects that the current account is allowed to read. |
| J39 | OneLink | 查看这个 App 绑定的 OneLink 和应用商店公开信息。 | Show this app's OneLink binding and its public app-store information. |
| J40 | Monetization aggregate | 按变现平台和广告位汇总上周每天的收入、展示和 eCPM。 | Summarize daily revenue, impressions, and eCPM for last week by monetization platform and ad placement. |
| J41 | Attribution aggregate | 汇总上周各渠道的归因新增、激活和付费表现。 | Aggregate attributed new users, activations, and payments by channel for last week. |
| J42 | User attribution | 我想下钻查看某个用户的归因来源和完整归因明细。 | Drill down into a specific user's attribution source and full attribution details. |
| J43 | Current table schema | 按表名查出这张数据表当前的 schema、字段列表和版本。 | Look up this data table by name and show its current schema, fields, and version. |
| J44 | Non-Bytedance hierarchy | 下钻查看快手和腾讯平台的计划、广告组和创意表现。 | Drill down into campaign, ad-group, and creative performance on Kuaishou and Tencent. |
| J45 | Platform creative | 查看各投放平台专属的素材和创意字段，不要只给通用素材目录。 | Show platform-specific creative assets and fields, not just the common creative catalog. |
| J46 | Analysis export | 把这次事件、分群、用户、付费或变现分析的结果导出成文件。 | Export the results of this event, segment, user, payment, or monetization analysis to a file. |
| J47 | Asset binary | 我有一个平台素材的精确引用，帮我预览或下载对应的图片和视频。 | I have the exact reference to a platform creative; preview or download its image and video. |
